prior_exposure_record.what: MacroState first-results model contest + bounded tree & neural comparison + missingness-only control (monthly, 12M horizon, 14 primitives -> 4 state composites). All verdicted WATCH on their own gate ladders, 2026-09-06.
prior_exposure_record.relation: SAME conceptual lineage (economic-state compression + shallow interactions), DIFFERENT contract: monthly origins/12M horizon vs this study's daily origins/20-local-session horizon; depth-3/7-leaf trees vs fixed depth-2/4-leaf 12-config grid; no nested PIT selection, no formal paired bootstrap/Holm inference. MacroState explicitly states its nonlinear stage was designed after earlier results were seen (development sequence, not fresh confirmation) and that the annual leader's edge collapses under a missingness/US-sleeve control.
prior_exposure_record.consequence: Recorded as prior exposure in registration hypothesis_text. This study is NOT fresh confirmation of MacroState and must not quote its numbers as such. Not a blocker: different target, sample, chronology, and inference contract.

conflicts_resolved.conflict: PRD's native-harness gate (P10) vs evaluate_signal.py's actual contract
conflicts_resolved.resolution: Harness evaluates ONE variable vs next-period return (NW-t/DSR/gross-Sharpe) — it cannot natively express the 20-session overlapping-label pooled-model contest. P10 binding = a frozen-prediction adapter that hands the harness the study's pre-computed cross-sectional score as if it were a signal column, or a documented 'native qualification unresolved' report. Decided at P10, recorded now.
